_comment: Versioned source of truth for Claude Code SessionStart hook entries this workspace wants present in the live, local ~/.claude/settings.json. Never symlinked wholesale -- that file also holds live runtime state (theme, autoMode, remoteControlAtStartup, etc.) that must stay local, see ~/dotfiles/.claude/CLAUDE.md. install_session_start_hooks.py merges these entries in idempotently (add-if-missing, matched by command string), never touching unrelated hooks like herdr-agent-state.sh. `{{HOME}}` in a command is substituted with the real, absolute home directory at install time -- Claude Code execs these command strings literally, no shell variable expansion, matching the pre-existing herdr-agent-state.sh/workspace-standards-review-check.sh entries which hardcode an absolute path for the same reason.
